title: Senior Resource Planner
description:
At Associated Electric Cooperative, we're committed to providing reliable energy to the communities we serve with passion and precision. We're a tight-knit team dedicated to keeping the lights on and the energy flowing smoothly across our expansive network!

From technical to operational to professional disciplines, our team brings a wide variety of skills, talents, and expertise to the table. We believe in both dedicating ourselves to excellence and investing in your growth.

As a Senior Resource Planner, you will help evaluate the generation portfolio and assist with resource decisions that will shape Associated's power supply for years to come.

This position combines power system modeling, economics, data analysis and strategic decision support. The Senior Resource Planner will evaluate complex questions involving generation resources, load, fuel, wholesale markets, emerging technologies and financial risk and turn that analysis into recommendations supporting significant business decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring electric utility or energy industry experience and established expertise in the area of resource planning. This is a senior technical contributor role with significant independence and responsibility for leading complex analytical projects.

What You'll Do

- Support development of Associated's Integrated Resource Plan, including evaluation of future resource needs

- Develop generation and energy modeling used in long-range financial forecasts, cost-of-service studies, portfolio analysis and other major planning efforts.

- Provide analytical support for generation investments, plant modifications, power supply contracts and other significant business decisions.

- Develop and improve analytical tools, models and processes used for resource planning and decision support.

- Collaborate with power production, energy marketing, fuels, finance, accounting, transmission, information services and other groups throughout Associated.

- Management of project scope, schedules, and coordination with leadership

- Packaging of results including technical writing and presentations intended for audiences without technical planning expertise

What you’ll need
This opportunity is part of a built-in career progression that includes Associate Resource Planner, Resource Planner, Senior Resource Planner, and Principal Resource Planner. Candidates will be placed at the level that best aligns with their skills and experience, with meaningful opportunities to continue growing their expertise, responsibility, and impact over time.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or another related technical field.

- Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in electric utility planning, generation planning, power markets, quantitative analysis or a related area.

- Track record of continued growth in technical capabilities and job responsibilities.

- Experience independently performing complex, non-routine quantitative or technical analysis.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

- Advanced degree in engineering or a related field.

- Strong understanding of electric utility generation, resource planning, wholesale energy markets or closely related areas.

- Experience with production-cost or capacity-expansion modeling software.

- Experience evaluating generation investments, power supply contracts or long-term portfolio alternatives.

- Experience with statistical, stochastic or financial modeling.

- Experience developing analytical tools or automating planning processes on large datasets using tools such as Excel, SQL, or Databricks.

What Associated provides:

- We are committed to rewarding talent with top pay. Your efforts will be recognized with a total compensation package that reflects your experience and contributions.

- Plan for your future with confidence! We offer a robust 401(k) program with a generous employer match to help you build the financial future you deserve.

- We know how important work-life integration is. Recharge with PTO and enjoy paid holidays, ensuring you have time to unwind and pursue your passions outside of work.

- Your health matters to us! Stay covered beginning on your first day of employment with our premier healthcare plan that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family.

At Associated Electric Cooperative, all of our 700+ employees across MO/AR/OK territory play a crucial role in powering our mission! Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find endless opportunities for career development here. Join us in an environment where your contribution is valued, and your career can thrive as we work together to keep the lights on!

title: Director, Load Integration

As Director, Load Integration, you will lead the integration and ongoing management of Associated Electric Cooperative’s large-load member relationships, connecting commercial, technical, operational, financial and contractual priorities across the cooperative. You’ll lead through influence across diverse teams, to create alignment, anticipate risk, drive decisions and establish scalable practices that support reliable member service and AECI’s long-term strategy.

What You’ll Do

- Lead end-to-end integration of large-load member relationships, from contract administration and project readiness through ongoing operations and performance.

- Lead cross-functional execution across engineering, system operations, transmission, planning, energy marketing, finance, legal, risk and other teams, driving accountability and results through influence rather than formal reporting authority.

- Oversee obligations and milestones associated with energy service, interconnection and operating agreements.

- Coordinate readiness for energization, load ramp, commissioning and ongoing operations while keeping complex, multi-year initiatives moving forward.

- Build trusted relationships with member leadership and ensure significant commercial, technical and operational issues are addressed effectively.

- Provide senior leaders with clear insight into performance, risks and decisions while developing repeatable standards for future large-load integration.

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, energy or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

- At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in the electric utility, energy, transmission, commercial or related field.

- Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional work through influence, accountability and sound decision-making.

- Working knowledge of electric utility operations, including power supply, transmission, interconnection, system operations, planning and reliability.

- Demonstrated experience with interpreting and administering complex commercial and technical agreements.

- Strong communication, relationship-building and organizational skills, with success operating independently in complex or evolving situations.

Preferred

title: Transmission Planning Engineer
description:
At Associated Electric Cooperative, we're committed to providing reliable energy to the communities we serve with passion and precision. We're a tight-knit team dedicated to keeping the lights on and the energy flowing smoothly across our expansive network!

From technical to operational to professional disciplines, our team brings a wide variety of skills, talents, and expertise to the table. We believe in both dedicating ourselves to excellence and investing in your growth.

As a Transmission Planning Engineer, you will help shape the reliability and future performance of the electric transmission system through power system modeling, transmission planning studies, and technical analysis. In this role, you will support Associated Electric Cooperative’s mission by building accurate models, analyzing system needs, and developing practical solutions that keep power moving safely and reliably. Tiny detail, massive impact, because electricity does not plan itself.

What You’ll Do

- Conduct load flow, short circuit, and stability studies to evaluate transmission system performance and identify solutions.

- Build and maintain transmission system models through regional model-building groups and in-house automation tools.

- Maintain accurate transmission planning databases by updating, validating, and communicating equipment data.

- Prepare clear technical reports, compliance documents, study summaries, and meeting notes.

- Collaborate with G&T partners, internal teams, and external organizations to support coordinated transmission planning.

- Contribute to transmission planning processes that support reliability, compliance, and long-term system needs.

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor of Science in electrical engineering or equivalent experience

- Typically 0 to 3 years of power industry experience for entry-level placement.

- Basic understanding of transmission planning, reliability standards, substation design, transmission line design, and protective relaying.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Acute attention to detail and the ability to review technical information for accuracy.

- Ability to work collaboratively in a professional office environment with occasional travel for meetings or cooperative-related work.

Preferred

- Power systems emphasis within an electrical engineering degree.

- Engineer in Training certification.

- Experience or coursework related to power system analysis, transmission planning, or reliability standards.

- Python experience

- AI experience

- EMT analysis

title: Reliability Compliance Specialist
description:
At Associated Electric Cooperative, we're committed to providing reliable energy to the communities we serve with passion and precision. We're a tight-knit team dedicated to keeping the lights on and the energy flowing smoothly across our expansive network!

From technical to operational to professional disciplines, our team brings a wide variety of skills, talents, and expertise to the table. We believe in both dedicating ourselves to excellence and investing in your growth.

Help Keep the Electric Grid Reliable

Associated Electric Cooperative, Inc. (AECI) is looking for a Reliability Compliance Specialist to help ensure the reliable operation of the bulk electric system by supporting our compliance with North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) standards.

In this role, you’ll partner with technical experts across the organization to develop, implement, and maintain our reliability compliance program. You’ll play an important role in preparing for audits, evaluating compliance risks, improving internal controls, and supporting initiatives that help keep our power system safe, reliable, and compliant.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and working in a highly regulated technical environment, we’d like to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

- Support and maintain AECI’s NERC Reliability Compliance Program.

- Interpret and implement new and revised NERC Reliability Standards.

- Partner with engineers, operations personnel, and business leaders to ensure compliance requirements are understood and implemented.

- Coordinate and support internal assessments and external compliance audits.

- Develop and maintain compliance documentation, procedures, evidence, and reporting.

- Perform compliance reviews, risk assessments, and internal control testing.

- Investigate potential compliance issues and assist with mitigation planning.

- Monitor industry developments, regulatory updates, alerts, and implementation guidance.

- Maintain compliance management systems and reporting tools.

- Assist with compliance awareness and training initiatives throughout the organization.

- Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and member-owner cooperatives to support a culture of compliance.

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering , Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work collaboratively across departments and influence without direct authority.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in the electric utility industry.

- Knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards or electric utility regulatory compliance.

- Experience in operations, engineering, maintenance, risk management, auditing, or compliance.

- Experience working with compliance management systems, document management systems, or governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software.

- Project management or audit experience is a plus.

What Makes You Successful

You’ll thrive in this position if you:

- Enjoy learning complex technical and regulatory requirements.

- Take ownership of projects from planning through completion.

- Can analyze information and identify practical solutions.

- Build strong working relationships with a variety of stakeholders.

- Maintain professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.

- Have a continuous improvement mindset and enjoy finding more effective and efficient ways to work.

Travel & Work Environment

- Hybrid work environment with office- based at AECI Headquarters in Springfield, Missouri.

- Occasional overnight travel for training, audits, or industry meetings.

- Flexibility to work outside normal business hours when business needs require .

Why Join AECI?

At AECI, you’ll work alongside industry professionals dedicated to maintaining one of the nation’s most reliable electric systems. We invest in our employees through ongoing development, technical training, and opportunities for career progression while fostering a collaborative culture focused on safety, integrity, and operational excellence.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on electric reliability while growing your career in compliance and the utility industry, we encourage you to apply.
